title: Strategic Narrative: Framework Behind Salesforce, Gong & Turing | Andy Raskin
description:
We’re joined by Andy Raskin, the storytelling strategist trusted by some of the most ambitious CEOs in Silicon Valley. Andy is best known for defining the modern strategic narrative, a high-level story that aligns leadership teams across sales, product, marketing, and fundraising. He is also the author of “The Greatest Sales Deck I’ve Ever Seen,” a breakout article with over 2 million readers, widely credited for transforming how startups communicate vision and differentiation. He has also led narrative alignment workshops at Salesforce, Turing, Gong, Uber, Square, VMware, Intel, Yelp and many others, helping teams write the stories that drive markets, motivate teams, and win customers. 

In this episode, Andy Raskin takes us inside the pursuit of strategic narrative— the storytelling discipline that has shaped some of Silicon Valley’s most successful companies. Andy breaks down how a strategic narrative transforms a company from “a seller of product” into a champion of a movement. He explains why founders must define a mindset shift in the world, why urgency matters, and how a narrative becomes the strategic North Star that aligns sales, marketing, product, and leadership. He shares the origin story behind his framework — from receiving a “1 out of 10, worst I’ve ever seen” business plan rating, to discovering narrative structure through screenwriting, to reversing-engineering Salesforce’s “software is over” pitch. Today, Andy Raskin opens up about the process, the philosophy, and the lived lessons behind the strategic narrative movement that defined his success.
